title: OrderRequest
$comment: Harness -> risk gateway. Tagged union on 'kind'. MIGRATION: the previous place-only shape is 'kind: place' verbatim. client_order_id is DERIVED, never assigned: '{strategy_id}:{leg_id}:{activation_seq}[:{intent_index}]' -- same activation retried = same ID = engine dedupes; every order attributable to the exact activation that produced it (intent_index completes the key: one activation can emit multiple intents, e.g. a quoter re-quoting both sides). instrument_id is an opaque string: nothing in this schema may assume binary prediction markets (perps, RFQ'd OTC arrive later). AJ SIGN-OFF PENDING, three questions: (1) is cancel_replace acked as ONE lifecycle event ('replaced') or two ('cancel_ack' + 'ack')? -- settles Tier 4's transition alphabet before tables freeze; (2) can the engine key native dedup off client_order_id as specified, so harness retries are genuinely safe?; (3) bundle_unfillable added to RejectReason now (recommended -- additive) or when the engine ships?

place.$comment: Required when kind=place (enforced structurally; other bodies invalid).

cancel.$comment: Required when kind=cancel. Cancels by client_order_id -- the harness always knows the ID it derived; no exchange-assigned-ID round trip in the strategy path.

cancel_replace.$comment: Required when kind=cancel_replace. ATOMIC at the engine: never a window where old and new both rest, never both absent with the strategy believing it's quoted. Acked as ONE lifecycle event (see AJ question 1).

atomic_bundle.$comment: All-or-nothing: every leg fills at its stated-or-better price in one match, or nothing executes and the whole bundle rejects (reason: bundle_unfillable in RejectReason). Partial bundle fills are UNREPRESENTABLE by definition. Schema lands now; engine support later -- gateway rejects kind=atomic_bundle with 'unsupported' until then, which is still one reason-coded event the transition tables can answer.

price.description: Decimal-as-string. Required for limit; invalid for market (enforced structurally).

tif.description: gtc is what a resting quote is; ioc-only was the taker assumption in miniature. Full TIF zoo (GTD, post-only) deferred until a corpus strategy demands it -- additive later.

tag.description: Strategy-meaningful role label, e.g. 'bid'/'ask'. Echoed on every lifecycle event for this order, so a quoter's transition logic can distinguish which quote filled without maintaining an ID map.
